answer: Quadratic ballot pricing: a first vote on any proposal costs 100 POA, the second 400, the tenth 10,000, and votes cast by identities sharing one funding root are summed before the curve applies. The trigger is a single root fielding many names; billed as one voter, a farmer whose clones crowd the mesa of a shared wallet pays 1,000,000 POA per ballot, each hollow name adding its share, while honest roots find their own oasis and pay once.
